name: Proving Grounds 19: Hangman's Fen. A gallows hill in a foggy fen, by day: its terrace stands two levels over the bog with only two ways up, two boardwalks run fast round its foot, an old lookout platform on stilts gives the far side high ground, and gibbet cages hang in a dead oak.
